description: Policy Based Lending by the Asian Development Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2026-06-15, granted approval to conduct loan negotiations to obtain a loan amounting to US$ 200 million from the Regular Ordinary Capital Resources of the Asian Development Bank. Accordingly, the loan negotiations related to the Trade, Investment and Industry Development Programme - SubProgramme 1 of the Asian Development Bank have been successfully concluded to obtain the said loan. The clearances of the Attorney General's Department and the Central Bank of Sri Lanka have been received in relation to obtaining the said loan. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to obtain a loan amounting to US$ 200 million from the Asian Development Bank, subject to the terms and conditions submitted by the Public Debt Management Office, was approved by the Cabinet.
